source(output(
		{COSTSHAR-EXEMPT-IND} as string,
		{CASE-NUMBER} as string,
		FPL as string,
		{ORIGINAL-RECIP-ID} as string,
		{COSTSHR-SENDER} as string,
		{GROSS-HH-INCOME-AMT} as string,
		{LEGACY-AID-TYPE} as string,
		{AS-OF-DATE} as string,
		{RECIP-COSTSHR-AMT-USED} as string,
		{RECIP-COSTSHR-APPRVD-AMT} as string,
		{COSTSHAR-BEGIN-DATE} as string,
		{COSTSHAR-MET-DATE} as string,
		{COSTSHAR-END-DATE} as string,
		{RECIP-COSTSHR-TRANS-AMT} as string,
		{TOT-NUM-OF-HH} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT	 [COSTSHR-SENDER], [ORIGINAL-RECIP-ID], [CASE-NUMBER], [AS-OF-DATE], [COSTSHAR-BEGIN-DATE], [COSTSHAR-END-DATE], [RECIP-COSTSHR-APPRVD-AMT], [RECIP-COSTSHR-AMT-USED], [RECIP-COSTSHR-TRANS-AMT], [COSTSHAR-MET-DATE], [COSTSHAR-EXEMPT-IND], [GROSS-HH-INCOME-AMT], [FPL], [TOT-NUM-OF-HH], [LEGACY-AID-TYPE] FROM [DATA_EXCHANGE].[EXTRACT].[IA_COST_SHARE_EXTRACT] ORDER BY [ORIGINAL-RECIP-ID], [COSTSHAR-MET-DATE]',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SourceIACostShareExtract
SourceIACostShareExtract sink(input(
		{COSTSHAR-EXEMPT-IND} as string,
		{CASE-NUMBER} as string,
		FPL as string,
		{ORIGINAL-RECIP-ID} as string,
		{COSTSHR-SENDER} as string,
		{GROSS-HH-INCOME-AMT} as string,
		{LEGACY-AID-TYPE} as string,
		{AS-OF-DATE} as string,
		{RECIP-COSTSHR-AMT-USED} as string,
		{RECIP-COSTSHR-APPRVD-AMT} as string,
		{COSTSHAR-BEGIN-DATE} as string,
		{COSTSHAR-MET-DATE} as string,
		{COSTSHAR-END-DATE} as string,
		{RECIP-COSTSHR-TRANS-AMT} as string,
		{TOT-NUM-OF-HH} as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		{COSTSHAR-EXEMPT-IND},
		{CASE-NUMBER},
		FPL,
		{ORIGINAL-RECIP-ID},
		{COSTSHR-SENDER},
		{GROSS-HH-INCOME-AMT},
		{LEGACY-AID-TYPE},
		{AS-OF-DATE},
		{RECIP-COSTSHR-AMT-USED},
		{RECIP-COSTSHR-APPRVD-AMT},
		{COSTSHAR-BEGIN-DATE},
		{COSTSHAR-MET-DATE},
		{COSTSHAR-END-DATE},
		{RECIP-COSTSHR-TRANS-AMT},
		{TOT-NUM-OF-HH})) ~> IACostShareFile
